mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.stock_code, p.title, p.content, p.writer, p.created_at, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS reply_count FROM Post p LEFT JOIN Comment c ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE p.stock_code = #{stockCode} GROUP BY p.post_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT post_id, stock_code, title, content, writer, created_at FROM Post WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Post (stock_code, title, content, writer, post_password) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{postPassword})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM Post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND post_password = #{password}
